Hospitality · Website + mobile redesign

Mellana Cafe

A warm welcome, from menu to order.

A café website and mobile experience that connects a warm visual identity with browsing the menu, choosing a drink, customizing an order, and reviewing the cart.

Format
Website and mobile interfaces
Focus
Brand expression, responsive UI, ordering flow
01 Overview02 Decisions03 Design04 Reflection

01 / The context

The experience behind the screens.

Mellana Cafe brings the atmosphere of a café into a digital experience. Cream backgrounds, dark coffee tones, warm accents, serif headlines, and drink photography create continuity between the brand story and the ordering interface.

The design challenge

The website needs to introduce the café and its character while making practical tasks easy to find. Menu browsing, drink options, and the cart should feel connected on desktop and mobile.

02 / Design decisions

What shaped
the experience.

01

Make the menu visual

Group drinks by category and use photography to make the selection easy to scan.

02

Keep customization close to the product

Put size, add-ins, and quantity alongside the selected drink, then carry the choices into the cart.

03

Create a consistent welcome

Bring the same warm colors, typography, and imagery to the home page, café story, navigation, and ordering screens.
